text:
marie: Dropped a trimmed launch blog draft + a concise benchmark appendix here: https://docs.google.com/launch-trim. Need copy lock by Thu EOD so design can finalize hero and ops can prep webinar routing. Quick pass? :sparkles:

ryan: On it. Two quick notes: (1) benchmark language needs p95 callouts, (2) hero options A/B in the doc — design prefers a shorter headline.

keiko: I'll pull p50/p95 per model and upload a CSV by 10:30. Will include sample sizes.

hani: For CTAs and routing proposal:
```
Top CTA: Start free trial -> no gate
Mid CTA: Request demo -> HubSpot form 66211 -> list: Demo_Inbound_April
Bottom CTA: Register webinar -> HubSpot form 66222 -> list: Webinar_Registrants_April
Add property: campaign=launch_apr_2026, source=launch_blog
```
Will we tag demo leads for SDR priority?

dylan: Yes — route demo leads to SDR_Inbound and set property priority=high for companies with >100 employees. Webinar regs go to Marketing_Nurture. I'll build workflows once forms are confirmed.

mia: Drafted webinar invite copy in the doc under section 'Webinar Invite v1' — short subject + 3 bullet benefits. Please thumbs up or suggest edits.

legal-bot: Automated scan: flagged phrase on line 34: 'bank-grade isolation'. Please remove or attach compliance link (SOC2).

marie: Replace with 'enterprise-grade controls' and link to https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2. I'll update now.

ryan: Also asking to call out (p95) next to the subhead to be transparent. e.g., 'Predictable, cost-efficient inference (p95 shown)'.

keiko: Uploaded latency CSV: https://drive.google.com/latency-apr.csv — contains p50/p95 by model and region, sample sizes in last tab. Sampling note: excludes requests < 64 tokens.

dylan: Great — that lets me include a small benchmark table in the hero asset. Design asked for a 1-line subhead to keep image readable. Recommend shorten to: 'Predictable, cost-efficient inference (p95)'.

mia: Reviewed webinar copy and trimmed subject line. Pasted updated text into doc. Also suggested CTA text: 'See it in action' for footer CTA.

legal-bot: Re-scan required. Will auto-clear when https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2 is present in doc. Reminder set for 12h.

marie: Copy lock checklist: (1) legal cleared phrasing, (2) benchmark CSV linked, (3) HubSpot form ids + workflow owners. Owners: marie -> legal chase, keiko -> data upload (done), dylan -> HubSpot workflows, mia -> webinar invite. React with :white_check_mark: when complete.

ryan: Quick micro-edit: change subhead to include 'cost-efficient' after 'predictable'. I'll push that tweak.
notes: short coordination thread for launch post copy lock, hero headline votes, benchmark callouts, and HubSpot routing
